_readme: 10-model flagship set for inference-optimization-daily.yml (the 8 fixed
daily models + the two amd Quark-MXFP4 MiniMax variants, added 2026-06-08).
Each run optimizes EVERY model below once. generate_hf_matrix.py carries
the framework / precision / tp / conc fields straight into the matrix; the
workflow forwards them as --manual --framework --precision --tp --concurrency
so per-model config is FIXED (no auto-detect).
Per-model MI300X baseline work-arounds are injected in code (keyed on the
model basename), NOT here, because the candidates schema has no env/image
field:
* Kimi-K2.6 -> SGLANG_ROCM_FUSED_DECODE_MLA=0 (fused-decode-MLA RoPE
kernel SIGABRTs during CUDA-graph capture at tp8).
* MiMo-V2.5-Pro -> image=mimo-profilerfix (the undated v0.5.11 profilerfix
base does not register MiMoV2ForCausalLM) + --attention-backend triton
(default aiter attention SIGABRTs during capture).
Both live at optimize_submit._sglang_image_for /
_workload_envs.materialize_config_with_envs.
MiniMax precision/tp: the original MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.x are FP8 block-128
and MUST run tp4 (1536/8=192 is not a multiple of 128). The amd/*-MXFP4
variants are Quark MXFP4 (group_size=32, only MoE experts quantized;
attention q/k/v/o + gate excluded); 192=6x32 so they COULD run tp8, but we
pin tp4 to match the FP8 M2.x parallelism for a clean FP4-vs-FP8 comparison.
If quark loading needs eager (quant_mode=eager_mode), add --enforce-eager.
repo_id MUST equal the model's sourceURL as registered in core42-hyperloom.

policy.rotation: none — the whole pool runs every dispatch (BATCH_SIZE=0).

candidates.label: DeepSeek R1
candidates.note: FP8-native upstream. MI300X has no native FP4; FP4 baseline failed to start, so baseline at FP8. sglang+tp8 starts cleanly.

candidates.label: Kimi K2.6
candidates.note: INT4 compressed-tensors native. vLLM tp8 hits MLA num_head%16 assert; sglang handles tp8 cleanly. ~554G weights -> ~69G/GPU at tp8. Code injects SGLANG_ROCM_FUSED_DECODE_MLA=0 (fused-decode-MLA RoPE capture SIGABRT work-around).

candidates.label: MiniMax M2.7
candidates.note: FP8 block-128 native. tp8 crashes: intermediate 1536/8=192 not divisible by 128. tp4 -> 384=3x128 OK, ~54G/GPU (no OOM).

candidates.label: MiniMax M2.5
candidates.note: FP8 block-128 native. Same tp8 192-not-div-128 crash as M2.7; tp4 OK (~54G/GPU).

candidates.label: Qwen3-Next
candidates.note: FP8-native. A3B MoE; tp8 keeps per-GPU memory low and starts fine.

candidates.label: Qwen 3.6
candidates.note: Ready (local /wekafs/models/Qwen-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Official repo has NO -Instruct suffix.

candidates.label: gpt-oss-120b
candidates.note: Ready (local_path /wekafs/models/openai-gpt-oss-120b). MXFP4-native — FP4 is a natural fit.

candidates.label: MiMo V2.5 Pro
candidates.note: vLLM lacks this arch; sglang moe_swa. ~963G -> tp8 (~120G/GPU). Code injects image=mimo-profilerfix (MiMoV2 arch) + --attention-backend triton (aiter attention capture SIGABRT work-around).

candidates.label: MiniMax M2.7 MXFP4
candidates.note: amd Quark MXFP4 (group_size=32; only MoE experts quantized, attention q/k/v/o + gate excluded). arch=MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM (vLLM supports). tp4 to match original FP8 M2.7 parallelism for clean FP4-vs-FP8 compare; group=32 also permits tp8 (192=6x32) as a later throughput bump. quant_mode=eager_mode may need --enforce-eager.

candidates.label: MiniMax M2.5 MXFP4
candidates.note: amd Quark MXFP4 (group_size=32; only MoE experts quantized). arch=MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM. tp4 to match original FP8 M2.5; group=32 permits tp8 later. quant_mode=eager_mode may need --enforce-eager.
